questions.stem_text: As of 2020, about what percentage of the world population practices open defecation?
questions.answer_explanation: The correct answer is 9% because this figure reflects the estimated proportion of the global population that lacks access to improved sanitation facilities, leading to the practice of open defecation, as reported by organizations such as the World Health Organization and UNICEF in their Joint Monitoring Programme for Water Supply, Sanitation, and Hygiene.

questions.stem_text: As of 2015, about what percentage of the world's land area is forested?
questions.answer_explanation: The correct answer is 30% because, according to the Food and Agriculture Organization, this figure represents the proportion of the Earth's land area that is covered by forests, highlighting the significant role forests play in global ecology and climate regulation.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following countries emitted the most CO 2 per capita in 2017?
questions.answer_explanation: Canada had the highest per capita CO2 emissions in 2017 due to its large fossil fuel extraction industry, significant reliance on oil and gas for energy, and low population density, which results in higher emissions per individual.
